captureDiscipline: await document.fonts.ready -> one warm-up __woRenderFingerprint() DISCARDED -> read the second call. Every run double-captures in-process and is rejected unless the two hash maps are byte-identical. ADDENDUM (measured 2026-07-27): one warm-up render is NOT enough on a freshly mounted editor — the background format-preview/decoded-asset queues keep mutating shared render state for a few seconds after mount, and a capture taken too early differs from the settled render in 113/144 cells with ZERO code change. Settle first: take round-trip-separated captures until two consecutive ones are identical (2 rounds observed), THEN do the in-process double capture.
